reference_sql:
WITH sales_side AS (
  -- one row: revenue in sales for March 2025 (order_date is the UTC day of order_ts)
  SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS sales_revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
), lines_side AS (
  -- one row: the same revenue worked out from the lines of the orders placed in March 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS lines_revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.sales_revenue, l.lines_revenue, s.sales_revenue - l.lines_revenue AS difference
FROM sales_side s
CROSS JOIN lines_side l

WITH sales_side AS (
  -- one row: revenue in sales for March 2025 (order_date is the UTC day of order_ts)
  SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS sales_revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_month = DATE '2025-03-01'
), lines_side AS (
  -- one row: the same revenue worked out from the lines of the orders placed in March 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS lines_revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) = TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.sales_revenue, l.lines_revenue, s.sales_revenue - l.lines_revenue AS difference
FROM sales_side s
CROSS JOIN lines_side l

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS r FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
), l AS (
  SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS r
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.r AS sales_revenue, l.r AS lines_revenue, s.r - l.r AS difference
FROM s CROSS JOIN l
